summary: Your feelings and your sense of structure speak the same language. You can hold a hard emotion without drowning in it. Emotional staying power comes naturally.
body: Your feelings and your sense of structure speak the same language. You can hold a hard emotion without drowning in it. Emotional staying power comes naturally. You're the one who stays calm when things get heavy, who can sit with a feeling long enough to understand it. It's a real gift, which is exactly why it's easy to lean on without ever developing it. The risk is coasting, letting the steadiness stand in for actually tending to what you feel. Aim it on purpose and it grows into wisdom.
gift: At your best: steady, grounded, the calm center people come to.
shadow: The trap: coasting on composure and never going any deeper than you have to.
integration: Let emotional needs and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Dependable under pressure; the risk is grinding joylessly.
do: Sit with a feeling long enough to learn from it
Lend your steadiness without absorbing the weight
Use the calm to go deeper
dont: Go numb and call it calm
